name: Kent County, MI
findings: Kent County has 2,476 nonprofit organizations. 1,115 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 904 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Kent County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for civic or political action
observations.text: 21 religious organizations here list civic or political action, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.
